doc_locator: Lei n.º 69/X/2025, BO I Serie n.º 133, 1.o Suplemento, de 31-12-2025, `Mapa VII` (PDF p.250); reprogrammed position at `Mapas_Contas_1o_Trim_2026_Site.xlsx`, sheet `Mapa VII_ Despesas por Programa`, row 16
notes: `Mapa VII - Despesa por Programa e Tipo de Financiamento` is the only table in the Cabo Verdean budget that states a digital line's **purpose** and its **financing origin** together. Columns: `Tesouro | OFN (Outras Fontes Nacionais) | FCP AAL | Donativo | Empréstimo | Total`. **`Tesouro + OFN` is the domestic-state share and is what this record carries**; `Donativo` and `Empréstimo` are external and are excluded by the origin gate. · The year is a quarter old and `actual_total` is deliberately left blank.** The only execution figure held is the `Conta Provisória I Trimestre 2026`, at 31 March 2026 - three months into a twelve-month year. Putting a three-month figure in `actual_total` would let a compile read it as the outturn and compute a false execution rate, so the Q1 execution is carried in `## Stage history` as a dated observation and nowhere else. `current_stage` is `revised`. · A rectificative budget was approved on 30-31 July 2026 and is not yet published.** Legislative elections on 17 May 2026 gave the PAICV an absolute majority and Francisco Carvalho's government took office on 19 June, replacing the administration that drafted and enacted this budget. The PM presented the *Orçamento Retificativo* on 29 July: OE 2026 voted at 95,675 million CVE, projected execution found on taking office at 104,011 million, the rectificativo setting 103,888 million. **As at 2026-08-04 the law is in neither the Boletim Oficial nor the ministry library**, so no revised statutory figure exists for this line. It will carry the first statutory revised `Mapa III` and `Mapa VII` this country has produced in the in-scope period. · THE THREE-YEAR HEADLINE: the appropriation has stopped describing the spend, and it is the organic vote that says so.** `Mapa III`, `01.03.02 GOV - Ministério Da Economia Digital`: appropriated **CVE 1,390,965,632 (FY2024) -> 369,781,930 (FY2025) -> 174,200,533 (FY2026)**, a fall of **87.5%** over two years while total state expenditure rose 11.3%. Investment appropriated at a printed **zero for the second consecutive year**. The ministry's whole vote is now **0.18% of state expenditure**, against 1.62% in FY2024. **And the reprogrammed budget did not move at all**: ORP 1,483,485,681 -> 1,472,731,889 -> **1,614,624,282 at Q1 2026**. By 31 March 2026 the ministry's budget is **9.3x what the Assembly voted it**, with CVE 653,127,161 of investment in existence that the budget law recorded as zero. **In Cabo Verde the virement register is the budget for digital and `Mapa III` is not.** · On the programme axis the domestic money is steadier than the vote.** The digital platform programme's domestic share runs CVE 568,184,541 (FY2024) -> 597,668,565 (FY2025) -> 476,994,724 (FY2026) - a 16% fall over two years, not 87.5%. The collapse is in the ministry's envelope, not in the state's own digital programme spending. · The external side of this programme was appropriated at zero for FY2026 and CVE 1.45bn of borrowing appeared inside three months.** That is the same in-year creation the organic axis shows, seen from the origin side. · Q1 execution context.** The whole state at Q1 2026 ran OI 95,675,087,738 -> ORP 102,678,336,652 (+7.3% already) -> EXE 19,117,570,518 = 18.6%. The digital ministry's organic vote managed 10.1%; state modernisation 13.2%. Q1 rates are low everywhere and must not be compared with the FY2024 and FY2025 full-year rates. · The PM's own number matches the reprogrammed budget.** Presenting the rectificativo on 29 July 2026, Francisco Carvalho said the OE 2026 "tinha um valor inicial de 95.675 milhoes de escudos" but that projected execution on taking office "ja apontava para 104.011 milhoes". The Q1 ORP of 102,678 million is that same drift, measured three months earlier by the ministry's own account. · `amount_usd` left blank.** No named fiscal-year-average CVE/USD rate is held; the escudo is pegged to the euro (110.265 CVE/EUR), so a dollar figure would be a two-step conversion the wiki cannot date to a named source.

notes: The law's own narrative (BO pp.125-127) inscribes these as new budget projects for 2026**: *"Inscricoes de novos projetos: 'Passaporte Eletrónico PEC/IMIJ' (142 milhoes de CVE); 'Cartão Nacional de Identificação CNI/IMIJ' (109 milhoes de CVE); 'Título de Residência de Estrangeiros TRE/IMIJ' (23 milhoes de CVE)"*, plus the inscription of an `Instituto da Modernização e Inovação da Justiça` project and a reinforcement of the `Fundo Modernização da Justiça`. **They are described as new, and the identical figures were already in the FY2024 and FY2025 annexes** - which is what the re-read of those two volumes established. · The SNIAC block is identical to the escudo in FY2024, FY2025 and FY2026** - 306,516,802 in total and 141,524,912 / 109,383,546 / 22,500,000 / 33,108,344 in its four sub-lines. notes: The law's own narrative (BO pp.125-127) inscribes these as new budget projects for 2026**: *"Inscricoes de novos projetos: 'Passaporte Eletrónico PEC/IMIJ' (142 milhoes de CVE); 'Cartão Nacional de Identificação CNI/IMIJ' (109 milhoes de CVE); 'Título de Residência de Estrangeiros TRE/IMIJ' (23 milhoes de CVE)"*, plus the inscription of an `Instituto da Modernização e Inovação da Justiça` project and a reinforcement of the `Fundo Modernização da Justiça`. **They are described as new, and the identical figures were already in the FY2024 and FY2025 annexes** - which is what the re-read of those two volumes established. · The SNIAC block is identical to the escudo in FY2024, FY2025 and FY2026** - 306,516,802 in total and 141,524,912 / 109,383,546 / 22,500,000 / 33,108,344 in its four sub-lines. Only the label of sub-line 9.4 changed, from `Funcionamento do SNIAC` to `Instituto Modernização e Inovação da Justiça`. **A three-year unchanged earmarked ceiling is a fee-financed authorisation rolled forward, not re-estimated.** · Origin caution, and both halves are true.** The identity systems are **domestically appropriated through an earmarked fee** *and* **externally co-financed**: a *Resolução do Conselho de Ministros* of 30 June 2026 authorised the Ministry of Justice to spend CVE 176 million on CNI/PEC/TRE production, stated to be provided in the IMIJ's budget for the current year; production moved from the Casa da Moeda de Portugal to the INCV's *Grafica de Segurança* on 18 May 2026, co-financed by the EU's GESTDOC project (EUR 5 million, via Camoes IP). **The EU money is not attributed to the fisc here, and the EU co-financing does not disqualify the domestic line.** · No double count with the programme-axis records.** The SNIAC lines sit in the Ministério da Justiça perimeter, inside the *Justiça e Paz Social* programme, which this pass does not record. · No outturn.** The Q1 provisional account reports by pillar programme, not by earmarked line. · `amount_usd` left blank.** No named fiscal-year-average CVE/USD rate is held; the escudo is pegged to the euro (110.265 CVE/EUR), so a dollar figure would be a two-step conversion the wiki cannot date to a named source.
